notes: Ticket 01 reproducible-build set for the UP profile (Raymer8639/linux-um-arm64 um-arm64-v0.3.0).
The kernel artifact is the published v0.3.0 release binary; the rebuilt binary differs by 1,040 B because the release used a non-stock clang flavor (MANIFEST omission).
The stub_exe-16k artifact is the 16 KB re-link produced by build-stub-16k.sh; the original 2,000 B stub is kept for comparison and is not part of this set.

build.env records the KBUILD_* pins required for a deterministic rebuild. build-bionic.sh does not export them itself, and the original release build environment is not fully recorded in the upstream MANIFEST.

toolchain.name: android-ndk
toolchain.compiler: Android (13989888, +pgo, +bolt, +lto, +mlgo, based on r563880c) clang version 21.0.0
toolchain.reproducibilityNote: stub_exe reproduces byte-for-byte (731c48d5...) with stock NDK r29; the kernel differs from the release asset by 1,040 B because the release clang flavor (dev, +pgo, -bolt, -lto, -mlgo) is not publicly available.

build.command: docker run --rm -v $PWD/src:/src -v $PWD:/work -e SRC=/src -e OUT=/work/out/build-up -e NDK=/work/android-ndk-r29/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64 -e KBUILD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP='Thu Jan 1 00:00:00 UTC 1970' -e KBUILD_BUILD_USER=orchestella -e KBUILD_BUILD_HOST=u1-kernel-build -e KBUILD_BUILD_VERSION=1 ubuntu:24.04 bash -c 'apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq build-essential bison flex bc python3 file && bash /work/research/uml-kernel-build/build-bionic.sh'

obligations: Convey the complete corresponding source (kernel tree at the pinned commit, stub sources and build rules) with the binaries, or a valid written offer valid for at least three years under GPL-2.0 section 3.
Include the scripts used to control compilation and installation: the pinned extracted config, build scripts, toolchain identity and the exact build command.
Include the pinned source (tag, commit, tarball sha256) that the binaries were actually built from; the GitHub release page is a pointer, not the conveyance.
Keep the source offer no narrower than the binary offer; when binaries are downloadable, equivalent source access from the same place is the baseline (GPL-2.0 section 3, last paragraph).
Record why the kernel is not byte-identical to the release asset (clang flavor) so the build recipe is auditable rather than implied; exact hash equality is not a GPL requirement.
Keep the GPL-2.0 text, copyright notices and this provenance record with every conveyed bundle.
This list records obligations for the research bundle; it is not a legal conclusion. The maintainer or ACR decides the distribution scope.
